messages:
noah: Quick sync0min: onboarding Kitsune-13B and Suzaku-7B together to compare quant pipelines. We found a cross-model failure mode where axis/permute hacks plus fractional rotary cause tokenizer-sensitive regressions on joined-emoji/ZWJ sequences. Repro and a tiny log below.

noah: repro (minimal):
```bash
# export both models to onnx fp16
python export_model.py --model kitsune-13b --out kitsune_fp16.onnx --dtype fp16
python export_model.py --model suzaku-7b --out suzaku_fp16.onnx --dtype fp16
# quantize with our AWQ path that may insert axis swap/permute
python quantize_awq.py --in kitsune_fp16.onnx --out kitsune_int4.onnx --opt axis_swap
python quantize_awq.py --in suzaku_fp16.onnx --out suzaku_int4.onnx --opt axis_swap
# run a short sample containing ZWJ / multi-codepoint emoji
python sample.py --model kitsune_int4.onnx --prompt "She said \u200d\u2764\ufe0f loudly" --log-tokens
python sample.py --model suzaku_int4.onnx --prompt "I \u2764\ufe0f pizza" --log-tokens
```

noah: sanitized logs: 
```
Kitsune FP16 tokens: [3,44,23789,7]
Kitsune INT4 tokens: [3,44,12111,7]
Kitsune embed cos_sim[0]: 0.998 -> 0.86

Suzaku FP16 tokens: [11,12879,4,2]
Suzaku INT4 tokens: [11,6534,4,2]
Suzaku embed dot[0]: 0.003 -> 0.12
```

noah: quick diagnosis notes: both failures boil down to two interacting things: (A) our quantizer inserts a global axis_swap / permute to reconcile proj layouts between families; (B) both models have nonuniform head dims or fractional rotary config (Kitsune uses freq_scale=0.75, Suzaku has hetero head sizes). The global permute assumes uniform head_dim and shifts proj offsets, which can change pre-embedding byte layouts for some tokenizer configs, so tokenization differs. When tokens are multi-codepoint (ZWJ/emoji) the small difference in embedding can cascade to big next-token prob changes.

alex: can you confirm tokenizer configs? are we running NFKC vs NFC differences between export and quantize steps?

noah: tokenizer snippets: Kitsune tokenizer: normalizer: "unicode_nfkc", pretokenizer: "byte-level", emoji_policy: "collapse_joined". Suzaku tokenizer: normalizer: "unicode_nfkc", pretokenizer: "whitespace+byte", emoji_policy: "char_split". So slightly different microshims.

tanya: this explains why Suzaku split the heart differently. Also permute before embed/proj can reorder weights such that byte-level offsets map to different token ids.

noah: I ran quantize with `--no-axis-swap` and both models preserved token ids for these prompts, but logits still drift a bit (RMS next-prob ~0.5-0.8%). So fixes need to address both the permute and the rounding/rotary constants.

alex: suggested fix list: 
- quantizer: when head_dims non-uniform or model.metadata contains "rotary:fractional", emit per-head reshape+transpose instead of single global permute.
- exporter: if rotary.freq_scale != 1.0 emit explicit rotary_freq initializer in the graph so axis/order transforms are less fragile.
- tokenizer: add an opt-in pre-normalize pass for onboarding that collapses common ZWJ/emoji sequences to canonical codepoints to stabilize baselines.
- CI: add a small emoji/ZWJ bench (20 prompts) to onboarding pipeline to catch regressions quickly.

noah: I prototyped `transform_weights.py --emit-per-head` change and `exporter` initializer change. Early bench (30 prompts) shows kitsune: parity 99.1% + BLEU delta 0.4; suzaku: parity 97.0% + BLEU delta 0.6. Without changes parity drops below 90 and BLEU delta >3.

tanya: add model-registry flags so pipeline auto-selects safe path for flagged models. Also add KV-cache smoke tests after per-head transforms since offsets shift.

ci-bot: created ticket #4901 for cross-model emoji/permute regressions and added to onboarding checklist.

alex: I'll open PR `quant/onboard-per-head-rotary-fix` with minimal repro, CI links, and a short checklist to run canary on Dedicated once merged. Tagging `onboard/kitsune` and `onboard/suzaku`.

noah: thanks. small follow-up: add a unit test for multi-codepoint emoji normalization in tokenizers repo (we keep missing ZWJ edgecases).

alex: noted. I'll include a quick tokenization unit test and the sample bench harness in the PR.

noah: summary: root cause = global permute/axis_swap + hetero head dims and fractional rotary + tokenizer microshim differences on ZWJ/emoji; mitigations = per-head permute/reshape, explicit rotary initializers, opt-in tokenizer canonicalization, onboarding emoji bench + KV-cache checks. Opening PR now. :rocket:
